reviews.title: 3+ yrs and still going strong
reviews.comment: I've just bought a new pc recently so i thought itd be appropriate to give love to this lil gpu. Ive had this for over 3 years and I've never had an issue with it. This was my first pc build and I'm more of a performance over aesthetitcs kinda guy so I've only ever run medium settings for every game I play in order to get 144fps to match my 144hz monitor. I've gone high settings and it handled it well, just didn't hit 144fps. All in all this thing is an insane bang for buck card and you can't go wrong with it. It's now going to my little sis and I'm sure we're going to be able to run it another 3+ yrs. 5+++++++ stars
reviews.author: krystal

reviews.title: Easy install, runs cool and quiet, 60+fps
reviews.comment: Was long overdue for a graphics upgrade. Booted up right away no issues. Installed driver's and was ready to game. No issue staying above 60+ fps even on my 60hz television im using temporarily. After 4 hours of taxing gameplay it never even went over 50°C
